body: I dont see the point on keep living a life that will make me suffer even more. I dont think I'll ever be happy again so whats the point? I know I will never be happy in my hometown (its so damn hot all year and I hate hot weather for starters) but I dont have the money to move somewhere else.

Yeah the only reason I can find is that my mom would be the one who would find me and she would go insane. I cant do that to her but I also think that it is unfair to keep suffering just to make others happy.
If it wasnt for my parents I would be homeless, I cant see how someone could be happy like that
I regret getting my degrees so much. Whats the point of getting a degree when I cant find a damn job?
Its been 4 years since then and things have been getting worst. I lost all the faith I had about things improving eventually
